name: Device Play Resource Request 1
definition: Content of the Play Request message.

ResponseMode.name: Response Mode
ResponseMode.definition: Message response awaited by the initiator of the Request.

ResourceAction.name: Resource Action
ResourceAction.definition: Requested Action: Start to play a media resource, Stop to play a media resource, Set the default volume.

SoundVolume.name: Sound Volume
SoundVolume.definition: Volume of a sound, either in a percentage of the maximum volume, or 0 to mute.

Resource.name: Resource
Resource.definition: Identification of the resource to use.

TimingSlot.name: Timing Slot
TimingSlot.definition: Identification of the moment to manage the media resource.
